summary: One-shot handler for the 'entering pits under red flag' scenario. Guarded by the latch this[0x180]: on first pass it records a state change to 2 via StateChangeNotify, captures the owner vehicle pointer *this, sets this[0x180]=1, updates the AI session phase via AISessionPhaseChange(dword_5EB978, owner), and processes the vehicle pit state via sub_4BC240(owner + 16436). When the race-start gate flag dword_8ACFC8 is 2 and penalties are enabled (dword_7CEF84), it either disqualifies the driver via DisqualificationHandler(aEnteringPitsUn) when the session type dword_7C56A4 is 7, or applies a time penalty via sub_4BBA90(aEnteringPitsUn, 1000.0).

local_names.v3: captured owner vehicle pointer read from *this
local_names.result: latch byte this[0x180] on entry; gate-derived value on the penalty path

operations.description: Read the one-shot latch this[0x180]; if it is already nonzero (handled), skip the entire body.
Record the state change to 2 via StateChangeNotify(this, 2).
Capture v3 = *this (owner vehicle pointer) and set this[0x180] = 1 to mark the scenario handled.
Update the AI session phase via AISessionPhaseChange(dword_5EB978, v3).
Process the vehicle pit state via sub_4BC240(*this + 16436).
Proceed to the penalty/disqualification path only when the race-start gate flag dword_8ACFC8 equals 2.
Proceed only when penalties are enabled, i.e. dword_7CEF84 is nonzero.
When the session type dword_7C56A4 equals 7, disqualify via DisqualificationHandler(aEnteringPitsUn); otherwise apply a time penalty via sub_4BBA90(aEnteringPitsUn, 1000.0).
Return the latch value when skipped, or the gate-derived value on the penalty path.
